about_the_game:
Each run in Fugue Shot presents a series of unique dreamscapes, filled with randomized and increasingly difficult encounters, puzzles, and challenges that will test your abilities to their limit. Can you overcome the ever-shifting landscape of this liminal and surreal world?

Test Your Skills Across a Variety of Minigames

Face a lineup of 8 distinct minigame types - each offering unique depth, strategy, and variety. No two runs are exactly alike. Take on physics puzzles, bullet-hell time trials, reaction-based challenges, and more as encounters grow increasingly challenging over the course of your run.

Power Up Your Run

Obtain any of over 100 unique items to impact your run and warp your playstyle. Discover powerful synergies and stat modifiers to create truly unique builds, allowing for emergent gameplay and a constantly shifting experience. Use mysterious tokens to alter levels to your liking, and chip away at dozens of permanent unlocks over the course of the game.

Enjoy an Eerily Beautiful World

Stunning pixel art and visual effects compliment a hypnotic and meditative soundtrack to create a surreal, dream-like atmosphere to lose yourself in.

short_description: Fugue Shot is a minigame roguelike set in a surreal dream-state world. Create your own solutions as you tackle ever-changing puzzles and challenges. Adjust and adapt by obtaining unique, synergistic items. Confront strange omens and apparitions to determine what is real, and what is a dream.
